execution.description: Added an opt-in operator resource profile to the miner research lane, so Carbon's own host can bound internal agent code while a miner's machine stays unlimited.

expected: Internal Graphite agent code on the shared operator host would be bounded so it cannot starve sealed work or data campaigns.
observed: The miner lane deliberately carried no resource limits, so the operator host relied on an exclusive host window to keep internal agent runs from competing with sealed work.
keep: Protect rather than narrow: bound Carbon's own host through an operator-written, owner-only profile, and leave a miner's own machine unlimited.
Fail closed when a host names a profile it cannot read, and verify after create that the container got exactly the profile.
change: An operator host can name CARBON_RESEARCH_RESOURCE_PROFILE; without it every argument is exactly as before.
